_site_url: The published address: link previews (og:image, og:url, twitter:image) need absolute URLs. Empty: derived from the repo (GitHub Pages).
_repo: owner/name on GitHub. CI passes $GITHUB_REPOSITORY, which wins; the site is served at https://mudassir-kidwai.github.io/video-creator-crew/.
_examples: The examples (and their media release) live in their own repository. The build reads them from --examples, else examples/ in this checkout, else examples_dir (a sibling clone); CI checks that repository out.
description: A local video studio for Claude Code: describe a video in one sentence, Claude directs, your machine renders. No cloud AI services, no API keys, no uploads.

hero._film: A release asset (examples/MEDIA.json); the workflow downloads it. The hero band loops the silent teaser in that folder and the button plays this film with sound.
